content: Customer Aaradhya Verma inquired about the coverage limits, exclusions, and procedures for alternative therapies regarding her health policy renewal. Agent Suresh Deshmukh responded by stating the coverage limit is ₹50,000 per year, experimental therapies are excluded, a PCP or specialist referral is required, and provided an attached brochure with further details.

action_items: Review the attached alternative therapies brochure
